living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/The Geneva Graduate Institute/Geneva Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies.pdf#page=2
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month exchange semester estimate: midpoint 1900 CHF/month (range 1800–2000 CHF) * 5 months * (1.1052 / 0.9266) = 11331.10 USD using ECB 2026-11-13 euro reference rates (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD, 1 EUR = 0.9266 CHF -> 1 CHF = 1.192748 USD, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html, collected 2026-11-15).
